page_title: HOL 5-1 AUG | Holstein Kiel v Augsburg 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+4' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
90+1' 5 - 1 Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
88' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch for Phil Harres.
87' A substitution has been made. Armin Gigovic is replaced by Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel).
87' Marcel Rapp has decided to substitute Finn Porath and he is replaced by Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel).
86' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Arne Maier (Augsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ruben Vargas (Augsburg).
85' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
83' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
82' The corner from Arne Maier (Augsburg) is intercepted by the defence.

81' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) is cleared to safety by the defence.

80' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom left corner, but Nediljko Labrovic pulls off a great save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Holstein Kiel manage to earn a corner.
79' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner which is cleared.

79' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
77' Arne Maier (Augsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
75' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) dribbles into the box, but Timon Weiner is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
73' Marco Komenda comes off the pitch to be replaced by Carl Johansson (Holstein Kiel).
72' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Marius Wolf will be replaced by Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
72' Kristijan Jakic goes off the pitch and Arne Maier (Augsburg) comes on.
72' The goal by Holstein Kiel won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
70' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Holstein Kiel players aren’t happy.
69' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 5:1.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' It is time for a substitution. Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) is on for Alexander Bernhardsson.
66' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) is able to continue to play.
65' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
64' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends the corner into the box, but Timon Weiner intercepts it and averts the threat.
59' Substitution. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Samuel Essende walks off.
58' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
57' It looks like Samuel Essende (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
56' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
55' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
54' Tobias Welz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel).
53' He should have scored! Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
52' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
50' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:3.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Elvis Rexhbecaj is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Augsburg).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+4' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Timon Weiner shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
45+2' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
45+1' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
42' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
42' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

39' 4 - 1 Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes inside the left post and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 4:1.
39' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Welz no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Holstein Kiel are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
35' 3 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 3:1.
32' 2 - 1 Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
31' Referee Tobias Welz has finally had enough of Marcel Rapp and brandishes a yellow card at him!
30' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.
26' Tobias Welz blows his whistle and it's Samuel Essende (Augsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Holstein Kiel are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
25' Holstein Kiel control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
22' What a chance that is! Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
19' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
15' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
14' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Henri Koudossou (Augsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
14' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Shuto Machino tees up Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Nediljko Labrovic.
11' Problems for Jess Thorup as Keven Schlotterbeck is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) replaces him.
10' Holstein Kiel take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
9' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
8' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' 0 - 1 Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
4' The Holstein Kiel players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Augsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has just begun.
Augsburg will kick the game off.
Tobias Welz was nominated as the referee for this game.
